notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the receive-order Send Interaction path exercised by Umbra's non-installable development profile. It selects only active ordinary subscriptions; passive subscriptions remain declaration state but do not arrange callback delivery. The active/passive delivery predicate is stated in the standard's passive-subscription definition, while the Lab's immutable Clause 5.1.3 candidate records the required active-or-passive state. The contract intentionally excludes the absent exported candidate for the Clause 5.1.3 published-class sentence (recorded separately as a Requirements Lab observation), timestamped behavior, DDM regions, directed interactions, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, custom transportation, and all evidence promotion. The public test uses a pre-existing IEEE-2025-schema fixture with Receive order and PublishSubscribe hierarchy; the private routing-kernel test additionally exercises the official Restaurant FOM hierarchy to cover descendant-parameter projection.
